newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil closes $2 down, Brent firm but off hig.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil closes $2 down, Brent firm but off hig.

text.p: IPE gas oil closed lower on Tuesday with fairly heavy mid-afternoon selling by a broking house on behalf of a trade customer the main feature in an otherwise uneventful session, dealers said.
Dec gas oil closed 42 cents down at $217 a tonne.
"It was pretty dull. (One broker) was selling quite heavily on Dec and Jan but nothing exceptional." said one broker.
The broker reportedly sold some 500 lots, or 50,000 tonnes on Dec and Jan.
Jan Brent was trading 14 cents higher at $22.67 a barrel at 1747 GMT.
"Brent went down earlier with the funds flushing out of (NYMEX) heating oil, but then rebounded," a broker said.
The contract touched an intra-day high of $22.93 a barrel as NYMEX unleaded gasoline pushed higher, before easing back.
"All the moves have come from the States," a trader said.

Dealers said Monday's bearish news that Iraq had agreed to all conditions for the oil-for-food deal was countered by expectations of cold weather this week on both sides of the Atlantic. No news emerged from the OPEC meeting in Vienna to undermine the market's expectation of a rollover of the group's 25.03 million barrels per day production ceiling.
